Chosen Ground.name: Chosen Ground
Chosen Ground.description: The user draws the fight onto ground that works against an opponent's strength: a slick floor against a charger, a low ceiling against a flier, a cluttered room against a sniper, open ground against an ambusher. While the fight stays there, the opponents lose the one advantage the user chose to deny: speed, reach, range, flight or surprise. Stamina: brief.
